tools.name: agentshell_get_config
tools.description: Get the full AgentShell configuration including zones, design, layout, widgets, and CSS variables.

tools.name: agentshell_set_css_var
tools.description: Set a single CSS custom property (variable) on the theme.

tools.name: agentshell_set_design
tools.description: Update design system values (colors, typography). All fields optional — only provided fields are updated.

tools.name: agentshell_list_zones
tools.description: List all declared zones with their current source type and configuration.

tools.name: agentshell_update_zone_composition
tools.description: Set or replace the ordered composition array for a zone. Accepts an array of block objects: { "type": "wp_loop" }, { "type": "widget", "id": "widget-id" }, { "type": "json_block", "content": "..." }, { "type": "wp_widget_area", "id": "widget-area-id" }.

zone_id.description: Zone ID: header, main, or footer

tools.name: agentshell_update_zone_slots
tools.description: Set or replace the slots object for a tri-slot zone (header or footer). Slots use a { left, center, right } structure. Each slot is an array of blocks.

zone_id.description: Zone ID: header or footer (only tri-slot zones support slots)

tools.name: agentshell_set_layout
tools.description: Update layout grid areas per breakpoint, gap, and padding.

tools.name: agentshell_get_site_info
tools.description: Get basic site information for agent context.

tools.name: agentshell_inject_json_block
tools.description: Inject raw HTML into a zone via json_block source. Style tags and inline style attributes are stripped for untrusted users (Unbreakable Grid). Admin users with unfiltered_html/manage_options preserve all tags including <style> and <script> for custom Web Components.

tools.name: agentshell_update_post_content
tools.description: Update a specific post/page HTML content via wp_update_post(). Style tags and inline style attributes are stripped for untrusted users (Unbreakable Grid). Admin users with unfiltered_html/manage_options preserve all tags including <style> and <script>.

html_content.description: HTML content to set as post content (max 100000 chars)

tools.name: agentshell_inspect
tools.description: Return a complete machine-readable model of the AgentShell site: shell, design, zones, widgets, content, capabilities, state, and warnings. Call this first when working on an unfamiliar site.

tools.name: agentshell_explain
tools.description: Return a human-readable plain-text description of the site: shell model, zone composition, widgets, and design — generated from live state.

tools.name: agentshell_validate
tools.description: Run deterministic validation over the site configuration: malformed config, unknown zones/widgets/core components, missing widget dependencies, unsafe json_block content, duplicate ids, auth configuration, and PHP/WordPress compatibility. Returns { errors, warnings } with stable codes.

config.description: Optional config to validate instead of the stored one (e.g. staged changes).

tools.name: agentshell_get_capabilities
tools.description: Return the capabilities of this AgentShell installation: design, zones, widgets, content, transactions, revisions, snapshots, profiles, preview, screenshot, audit. Call this before planning work on an unfamiliar installation.

tools.name: agentshell_get_audit_log
tools.description: Return the audit history of configuration changes: timestamp, actor, operation, affected CSS tokens, revision id. Newest first, max 100 entries.

tools.name: agentshell_begin_transaction
tools.description: Open a transactional change session. Until committed or rolled back, every config mutation is staged in a buffer instead of the database — the live site stays untouched. Make multiple changes, validate, preview the diff, then commit or roll back.

label.description: Short human-readable description, e.g. "switch to dark palette"

tools.name: agentshell_get_transaction
tools.description: Return the open transaction (id, label, actor, staged state) or null if none is open.

tools.name: agentshell_preview_transaction
tools.description: Return a token-level diff of everything staged in the open transaction against the live config: added, removed, changed tokens. Nothing is persisted.

tools.name: agentshell_validate_transaction
tools.description: Run the site doctor against the staged configuration of the open transaction. Returns errors and warnings. Errors must be resolved before commit will succeed.

tools.name: agentshell_commit_transaction
tools.description: Validate and apply all staged changes of the open transaction in one atomic write. Records a revision and audit entry. Fails (with no changes applied) if validation errors exist.

tools.name: agentshell_rollback_transaction
tools.description: Discard all staged changes of the open transaction. The database was never touched while the transaction was open, so the live site is unaffected.

tools.name: agentshell_list_revisions
tools.description: List configuration revisions (newest first): id, parent, timestamp, actor, label. Each config mutation creates one revision.

tools.name: agentshell_diff_revisions
tools.description: Compare two configuration revisions at the CSS-token level. Returns added/removed/changed tokens between the two states.

to.description: Revision id, e.g. r15. Omit to diff from-revision against the current live config.

tools.name: agentshell_restore_revision
tools.description: Restore the live configuration to a previous revision. The restore itself is recorded as a new revision and audit entry, so it is always reversible.

id.description: Revision id to restore, e.g. r12

label.description: Optional note recorded with the restore

tools.name: agentshell_create_snapshot
tools.description: Capture the full current configuration as a named snapshot. Snapshots are restorable (agentshell_restore_snapshot), diffable, and exportable as theme packages. Max 20 snapshots (oldest dropped).

tools.name: agentshell_list_snapshots
tools.description: List all saved configuration snapshots with name, label, actor, and timestamp.

tools.name: agentshell_restore_snapshot
tools.description: Restore the live configuration from a named snapshot. Recorded as a new revision and audit entry, so it is reversible with agentshell_restore_revision.

tools.name: agentshell_diff_snapshot
tools.description: Token-level diff between a saved snapshot and the current live configuration.

name.description: Snapshot name to diff against the live config

tools.name: agentshell_get_design_system
tools.description: Return the design system in structured groups (palette, typography, geometry, custom vars) plus the flat token map. Prefer this over raw CSS variables when reasoning about design.

tools.name: agentshell_set_palette
tools.description: Update palette colors semantically. Keys: background, surface, text, border, accent, primary, secondary. Values must be hex (#rgb/#rgba/#rrggbb/#rrggbbaa). Only provided keys change.

tools.name: agentshell_set_typography
tools.description: Update typography: fontFamily (CSS font stack), mono (monospace font), baseSize (base spacing/font unit, e.g. 1rem), scale (type scale multiplier). Only provided keys change.

fontFamily.description: CSS font stack, e.g. "Inter, system-ui, sans-serif"

tools.name: agentshell_set_spacing
tools.description: Set the base spacing unit (drives --spacing-base and the theme's space scale), e.g. "1rem" or "8px".

tools.name: agentshell_set_shape
tools.description: Set shape tokens: radius (base corner radius, e.g. 8px or 0px for a sharp look), borderWidth (e.g. 1px, 2px), borderStyle (solid, dashed, none). Only provided keys change.

tools.name: agentshell_save_theme_profile
tools.description: Save the current design (or an explicit design object) as a named theme profile. Profiles can be applied (agentshell_apply_theme) and previewed (agentshell_preview_theme).

design.description: Optional design object { colors, typography, layout, custom_css_vars }. Omit to capture the current live design.

tools.name: agentshell_list_theme_profiles
tools.description: List all saved theme profiles (name, description, actor, timestamp, design summary).

tools.name: agentshell_apply_theme
tools.description: Apply a saved theme profile: merge its design (colors, typography, geometry, custom vars) into the live configuration. Recorded as a revision and audit entry.

tools.name: agentshell_preview_theme
tools.description: Get a preview URL for a saved theme profile. The profile's design tokens are rendered as CSS overrides (no config change). Requires a logged-in browser session to view.

tools.name: agentshell_export_theme
tools.description: Export the full AgentShell configuration as a portable theme package (JSON manifest): design, zones, layout, widgets. Import on another installation with agentshell_import_theme.

snapshot.description: Optional snapshot name to export instead of the live config

tools.name: agentshell_import_theme
tools.description: Import a theme package (from agentshell_export_theme) and apply it. Accepts the manifest object or a raw JSON string. Validated before applying; recorded as a revision.

manifest.description: Exported manifest object { package, version, config }

json.description: Raw JSON manifest string (alternative to manifest)

tools.name: agentshell_list_widgets
tools.description: List all registered widgets — stable (file-based) and agent-defined — with lifecycle status (active/disabled), required libraries, and source.

tools.name: agentshell_enable_widget
tools.description: Enable a widget: set its status to active so zones render it again. Works for both config-registered and stable file widgets.

tools.name: agentshell_disable_widget
tools.description: Disable a widget: set its status to disabled so zones render nothing for it. Registration is preserved, so it can be re-enabled. Prefer this over removal for stable file widgets.

tools.name: agentshell_remove_widget
tools.description: Permanently remove a config-registered (agent-defined) widget from the registry. Stable file widgets cannot be removed — disable them instead. Zones referencing the removed widget will render nothing.

tools.name: agentshell_create_page
tools.description: Create a WordPress page with raw HTML content (no wpautop/kses — content is preserved exactly). Returns the created record incl. edit URL.

content.description: Raw HTML content. No script tags or inline event handlers — they are stripped by WordPress core for non-super-admin users.

tools.name: agentshell_create_post
tools.description: Create a WordPress post with raw HTML content (no wpautop/kses — content is preserved exactly). Returns the created record incl. edit URL.

content.description: Raw HTML content. No script tags or inline event handlers — they are stripped by WordPress core for non-super-admin users.

tools.name: agentshell_update_content
tools.description: Update an existing post or page (title, raw HTML content, status, slug, or page parent). Returns the updated record.

content.description: New raw HTML content (replaces the whole body)

tools.name: agentshell_publish
tools.description: Publish a post or page (status draft/pending/private/future -> publish). Returns the updated record.

tools.name: agentshell_unpublish
tools.description: Unpublish a post or page (status publish -> draft). Returns the updated record.

tools.name: agentshell_search_content
tools.description: Search posts/pages by title or body text (empty query lists most recently modified). Returns compact records: id, title, type, status, date, modified, excerpt.

query.description: Search term; empty lists recent content

tools.name: agentshell_get_content
tools.description: Fetch a single post or page: title, status, slug, raw HTML content and the rendered HTML as the theme outputs it, plus edit URL and link.

tools.name: agentshell_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of the site (or a saved theme profile preview) at a given viewport using the headless browser installed on the server. Returns the image URL. Backend: Chrome/Chromium headless; configure AGENTSHELL_CHROME_BIN if not on PATH.

width.description: Explicit viewport width in px (overrides viewport preset)

height.description: Explicit viewport height in px (overrides viewport preset)

url.description: URL to capture (defaults to the site home page)

profile.description: Optional theme profile name — the screenshot renders its design tokens as preview overrides (requires AGENTSHELL_REST_TOKEN)

tools.name: agentshell_register_widget
tools.description: Register or update an agent-defined widget in the blocks registry.

tools.name: agentshell_unregister_widget
tools.description: Remove an agent-defined widget from the blocks registry.

tools.name: agentshell_get_widget
tools.description: Get a single widget definition by ID.
